concerns.text: FR‑012 requires the pipeline to *enforce* RAM ≤ 7 GB and wall‑clock ≤ 6 h. T014 only records resource usage; there is no task that asserts the limits, so the functional requirement is uncovered.

FR‑014 mandates acquiring ≥ 500 post‑2025 GitHub‑issue logs. T005 streams logs from `mlfoundations/agent_logs`, which does not satisfy the required source or temporal constraint, leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

Task tags use `[US1]`, `[US2]`, `[US3]` whereas the specification defines user stories as `US-01`, `US-02`, `US-03`. These tags reference nonexistent IDs, creating stale references that break traceability.
